units.source_text: 在一个远离你俩下榻的旅馆的洗澡间里，

en.t: In a bathroom far from the inn where the two of you were staying,

units.source_text: 我嗅到了你和新娘子的新床上的香水气味，

en.t: I smelled the scent of perfume from the new bed you shared with your bride,

units.source_text: 我灵魂的一扇门扉完全关闭了。

en.t: and a door in my soul closed completely.
